title: Khaane ke baad ek baat
caption:
Kabhi mann hua ki bas koi sun le? Aap kis se baat karna chahenge? 👇
Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a young man who uses Waypoint to be paired for a short chat with another adult who is also looking to talk. For adults 18 and over; not a counselling or crisis service.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Karan: Karan is a young man in his late twenties with short wavy hair, a navy t-shirt and a tired but kind face.
cast.Mother: Karan's mother is a woman in her fifties in a cotton saree, clearing plates in the background.

scenes.vo: खाना ख़त्म हुआ, घर में सब अपने कमरों में थे।
scenes.sub: Khaana khatam hua, ghar mein sab apne kamron mein the.
scenes.art: Karan sitting alone at a dining table after dinner, empty plates, his mother walking away with a tray, warm lamp light.

scenes.vo: करण का मन कुछ कहने को हो रहा था।
scenes.sub: Karan ka man kuch kehne ko ho raha tha.
scenes.art: Karan leaning on his elbow looking at a quiet window, city lights outside.

scenes.vo: पर किससे? सब थके हुए थे।
scenes.sub: Par kisse? Sab thake hue the.
scenes.art: Karan glancing at the closed doors of the house, long hallway, soft shadows.

scenes.vo: उसने वेपॉइंट का चैट वाला हिस्सा खोला।
scenes.sub: Usne Waypoint ka chat wala hissa khola.
scenes.art: Karan sitting on the sofa opening an app on his phone, curious look.

scenes.vo: बताओ क्या ढूँढ रहे हो, किससे मिलना है।
scenes.sub: Batao kya dhoondh rahe ho, kisse milna hai.

scenes.vo: फिर दबाओ, किसी से बात करने के लिए।
scenes.sub: Phir dabao, kisi se baat karne ke liye.

scenes.vo: कुछ सेकंड इंतज़ार, स्क्रीन पर धीमी रोशनी।
scenes.sub: Kuch second intezaar, screen par dheemi roshni.
scenes.art: Karan holding his phone in both hands waiting, a soft pulsing glow on the screen lighting his face.

scenes.vo: एक और इंसान भी उसी वक़्त ढूँढ रहा था।
scenes.sub: Ek aur insaan bhi usi waqt dhoondh raha tha.
scenes.art: Two small phone icons connected by a thin warm line over a night city skyline, gentle illustration.

scenes.vo: दोनों की छोटी सी बातचीत शुरू हुई।
scenes.sub: Dono ki chhoti si baatcheet shuru hui.
scenes.art: Karan smiling softly at a chat on his phone, relaxed shoulders, lamp light.

scenes.vo: कोई सलाह नहीं, बस कोई सुन रहा था।
scenes.sub: Koi salah nahi, bas koi sun raha tha.
scenes.art: Karan breathing out with a relieved smile, window now showing early stars.

scenes.vo: आज रात आप किससे बात करना चाहेंगे?
scenes.sub: Aaj raat aap kisse baat karna chahenge?
scenes.art: Close-up of Karan smiling gently at the viewer, sofa softly blurred behind.
